When purchasing a ferry ticket, they text people hours later, saying the departure time was 3:00 PM, and they changed it from 3:00 PM to 12:00 PM. People who come from far away and have already scheduled their arrival times for the ferry end up with their entire travel plans messed up. On top of that, they sell tickets online. You arrive at the port gate with your online ticket and PNR number. The police or security at the gate don't recognize the online ticket sold to you with the PNR number. They turn you away at the gate, saying you're going to the fleet company's online ticket in that heat. Imagine, you're looking for a taxi, and when you arrive at the office, a smug office manager named Selcuk threatens you by saying you can't yell at us and that you'll have to wait for the ferry ticket process. Also, when the ship arrived in Kyrenia, they set up a platform for the passengers to disembark. It was a real treat for the housemates. What can I say? It was a total cowboy thing.
